title: Experiment Design for Set-membership Identification: From Prior Knowledge to Universal Inputs
summary: We consider the problem of designing input signals for an unknown linear time-invariant system in such a way that the resulting data, within a finite horizon, is suitable for identification with a desired accuracy. We consider both noise-free and noisy settings with $\ell_\infty$--bounded noise models. We will take into account general prior knowledge of the system parameters. Central in our study is the concept of universal inputs.
